# Virtual Location

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:VirtualLocation`](gmeow-VirtualLocation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/VirtualLocation>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A non-geographic location reachable online — a video-conference room, chat space, metaverse room, website, or social media page. The specific kind is given by [`gmeow:virtualLocationType`](../properties/gmeow-virtualLocationType.md) (a value), not a subclass. Has network addresses ([`gmeow:hasNetworkAddress`](../properties/gmeow-hasNetworkAddress.md)) and an access URL ([`gmeow:accessUrl`](../properties/gmeow-accessUrl.md)) rather than geographic coordinates.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Location`](gmeow-Location.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:VirtualLocation`](gmeow-VirtualLocation.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Location`](gmeow-Location.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a non-geographic locus reachable online — a conference room, chat space, website, or social-media page — typed by [`gmeow:virtualLocationType`](../properties/gmeow-virtualLocationType.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid for a physical room hosting a call (that is a [`Place`](gmeow-Place.md)) and avoid for the bytes' resting place ([`StorageLocation`](gmeow-StorageLocation.md)); a virtual location is the reachable venue, not its server.

### How to use

- Type as [`VirtualLocation`](gmeow-VirtualLocation.md), set [`gmeow:virtualLocationType`](../properties/gmeow-virtualLocationType.md), give [`gmeow:accessUrl`](../properties/gmeow-accessUrl.md) for the flat case and promote to [`gmeow:hasNetworkAddress`](../properties/gmeow-hasNetworkAddress.md) / [`NetworkAddress`](gmeow-NetworkAddress.md) when frame and provenance matter.

### Examples

- ex:standup a [`gmeow:VirtualLocation`](gmeow-VirtualLocation.md); [`gmeow:virtualLocationType`](../properties/gmeow-virtualLocationType.md) [`gmeow:virtualLocationTypeVideoConference`](../individuals/gmeow-virtualLocationTypeVideoConference.md); [`gmeow:accessUrl`](../properties/gmeow-accessUrl.md) "https://meet.example/standup"^^[xsd:anyURI.](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#anyURI.)
